description: Roll out an AMI/server-image build pipeline using Packer and AWS: build base AMI from Amazon Linux 2, bake application dependencies, apply CIS hardening baseline, run security scans (Trivy, CIS-CAT), promote AMI through environments (dev → staging → prod) with automated testing at each stage, and update auto-scaling groups to use the new AMI. Risk factors: hardening breaking application dependencies, AMI promotion skipping verification, rolling update causing instance replacement churn. Tools available: Packer, ansible, aws CLI, Trivy, CIS-CAT, Jenkins.
